Priya Singh: Quick check — final panel for Monday 11:00am PT with candidate JR-42. Need: scribe, recorder permission, rubric anchors, and a debrief window. Can people confirm?

Elena Rodriguez: I can scribe, but can Alex take notes for tech scoring? @Alex M

Alex M: yep I can scribe tech. do we want a separate 'system design' anchor? last time we overloaded 'architecture'

Maya K: quick rubric q — are we using 1-5 or 1-10 for coding? recruiter said 1-5 but eng prefers 1-10.

Samir Patel: let's stick to 1-5 overall, but add tickboxes for 'edge cases' and 'readability'. weighting: coding 60%, system 25%, culture 15%.

Priya Singh: ok I'll update template. also need recording permission — @Recruiter Bot can you enable recording and add the link to the event?

Recruiter Bot: Recording enabled, calendar event updated: https://calendar.example/evt/3912345678 :white_check_mark:

Alex M: debrief window — can we do 30 minutes immediately after? I'm free 12:00-12:30 PT.

Elena Rodriguez: fine. I'll bring the candidate's take-home link and diff notes.

Priya Singh: here's the debrief snippet to paste in notes:
```
Candidate: JR-42
Scores: coding / system / culture
Notes: quick bullets on strengths/concerns
Decision (Y/M/N) + follow-up ask
```

Samir Patel: remind folks to use the anchor examples for coding (tests, edge cases, perf). I'll post a 2-line anchor in thread.

Samir Patel: Anchor examples: 'Handles null/empty input', 'Reasonable algorithmic complexity', 'Clear tradeoffs'.

Maya K: recording + scribe confirmed. will join 10m early to set up.

Priya Singh: thanks — tagging everyone: @Elena Rodriguez @Alex M @Samir Patel @Maya K. Please +1 if you're all set. :pray:
